plan: Target is a two-hand prayer/namaste (anjali) gesture: mirror-symmetric palms facing each other and pressed together at the midline, wrists separated below, fingers extended upward and together with fingertips aligned/touching. Each hand’s four fingers are nearly straight with slight natural flexion, minimal spread; thumbs flex across the palm and meet/lie alongside the opposite index area. Orient each hand with palms facing inward (toward the other hand), fingers vertical, and bring the hands together at the midline.
